# CrowdStrike Developer Center

> Documentation for the CrowdStrike Falcon platform APIs, SDKs, and Configuration as Code tools. Build integrations, automate security operations, and manage your Falcon environment programmatically.

## Sections

> For the complete version of this document with all 1388+ individual API operations listed, see [llms-full.txt](https://www.falconpy.io/llms-full.txt)
- [Falcon API Reference](https://www.falconpy.io/api-reference/overview/): CrowdStrike Falcon API reference documentation.
- [Falcon Foundry](https://www.falconpy.io/foundry/understanding-foundry/): Build custom apps, API integrations, and automated workflows directly on the CrowdStrike Falcon platform.
- [Configuration as Code](https://www.falconpy.io/cac/overview/): Manage the CrowdStrike Falcon platform using Configuration as Code with Terraform.
- [Falcon MCP](https://www.falconpy.io/falcon-mcp/overview/): Connect AI assistants to the CrowdStrike Falcon platform via the Model Context Protocol.
- [Sensor Deployment](https://www.falconpy.io/falcon-sensor/overview/): Deploy, configure, and manage the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor across your infrastructure.
- [Falcon Next-Gen SIEM](https://www.falconpy.io/ngsiem/overview/): Build custom parsers, normalize security data, and integrate third-party log sources with CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM.
- [Software Development Kits](https://www.falconpy.io/sdks/overview/): Official CrowdStrike Falcon SDKs. Six languages, full API coverage.

## API Reference

- [All Operations](https://www.falconpy.io/api-reference/all-operations/): Complete alphabetical list of all 1388+ API operations
- [Operations by Collection](https://www.falconpy.io/api-reference/operations-by-collection/): Operations grouped by service collection
- [Falcon Query Language](https://www.falconpy.io/api-reference/falcon-query-language/): FQL syntax reference for filtering API results

## Authentication

All API access requires OAuth2 credentials (client_id and client_secret) created in the Falcon console under Support and resources > API Clients & Keys. Tokens expire after 30 minutes. Base URLs vary by cloud region: us-1 (api.crowdstrike.com), us-2 (api.us-2.crowdstrike.com), eu-1 (api.eu-1.crowdstrike.com), us-gov-1 (api.laggar.gcw.crowdstrike.com).
